blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A rare plant species believed to have been lost has been rediscovered in the limestone forests of Masungi in Rizal province. The Masungi Georeserve announced the discovery on Facebook on Sunday, Sept. 13, saying the rare species, which is endemic to the Philippines, is now blooming along its Discovery Trail.
